The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] '''raided''' the [[74th Imperial Garrison]] [[Time/Legends|sometime]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Prefab shelter|Prefab buildings]] taken by rebels during the event were later used on [[Jagomir]].
